title: Compatible-tower composition commutes with proper refinements

proof.text:
Let $R$ be the square with top open $b_1:U_1\to\bar X_1$, bottom open $b_2:U_2\to\bar X_2$, and proper verticals $w,v$. Its commutativity is $vb_1=b_2w$. By [lem-cbc-proper-open-interchange-coherence] it has the normalized natural comparison $\delta=\gamma_R:b_{2!}W\to Vb_{1!}$, without requiring the square to be cartesian. Place to its left the refinement square with top $c_1$, bottom $c_2$, and verticals $\mathrm{id}_X,w$. The horizontal composite has top $a_1$, bottom $a_2$, and verticals $\mathrm{id}_X,v$. The refinement normalization of the cited node identifies the comparisons for these two refinement squares with $\alpha_w$ and $\alpha_v$. Its horizontal composition equation therefore gives
$$\alpha_v=(\delta c_{1!})\circ(b_{2!}\alpha_w):a_{2!}\longrightarrow V a_{1!}.$$
Here the open-extension identifications are precisely those fixed in step 1.

Paste $R$ vertically above the second tower square $(b_2,i_2,p_{Y,2},p_2)$. Its outer rectangle has top $b_1$, bottom $i_2$, left $p_{Y,2}w=p_{Y,1}$ and right $p_2v=up_1$. The same rectangle is obtained by placing the first tower square $(b_1,i_1,p_{Y,1},p_1)$ above the refinement square $(i_1,i_2,\mathrm{id}_Y,u)$. The vertical composition equation and refinement normalization of [lem-cbc-proper-open-interchange-coherence], applied to these two decompositions of this identical rectangle, give
$$(P_2\delta)\circ(\gamma_2 W)=(U\gamma_1)\circ(\alpha_u S_1):i_{2!}S_1\longrightarrow UP_1b_{1!}.$$
The first decomposition uses only proper verticals $w,v,p_{Y,2},p_2$; the second uses $p_{Y,1},p_1,\mathrm{id}_Y,u$. All are supplied by the hypotheses or step 1. Thus neither decomposition invokes a base-change theorem for a noncartesian square.

For $K\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$ apply naturality of $\gamma_2:i_{2!}S_2\to P_2b_{2!}$ from [lem-cbc-proper-open-interchange-coherence] to the morphism $\alpha_{w,K}:c_{2!}K\to Wc_{1!}K$. It says exactly
$$(P_2b_{2!}\alpha_w)\circ(\gamma_2c_{2!})=(\gamma_2Wc_{1!})\circ(i_{2!}S_2\alpha_w).$$
Both sides map $i_{2!}S_2c_{2!}$ to $P_2b_{2!}Wc_{1!}$. This is the ordinary component naturality equation, for every $K$; no further geometric comparison is used.

proof.text:
Expand $C_{hf}\mu_2$ and use step 2, then step 4, then step 3 whiskered by $c_{1!}$. Functoriality of $Q_2,P_2$ gives the chain
$$\begin{aligned}
C_{hf}\mu_2
&=Q_2\big((P_2\alpha_v)\circ(\gamma_2c_{2!})\big)\\
&=Q_2\big((P_2\delta c_{1!})\circ(P_2b_{2!}\alpha_w)\circ(\gamma_2c_{2!})\big)\\
&=Q_2\big((P_2\delta c_{1!})\circ(\gamma_2Wc_{1!})\circ(i_{2!}S_2\alpha_w)\big)\\
&=Q_2\big((U\gamma_1c_{1!})\circ(\alpha_u S_1c_{1!})\circ(i_{2!}S_2\alpha_w)\big)\\
&=\mu_1\circ(C_hF_1)\circ(H_2C_f).
\end{aligned}$$
For the last equality substitute $F_1=S_1c_{1!}$, $C_f=S_2\alpha_w$, $C_h=Q_2\alpha_u$, $Q_2U=Q_1$ and $\mu_1=Q_1\gamma_1c_{1!}$ with the terminal compositors. The first equality uses $R(q_2p_2)_*=Q_2P_2$; its target uses $Q_2P_2V=Q_2UP_1=Q_1P_1$. The equality of these triple-composition identifications is exactly [lem-cbc-etale-derived-direct-image-coherence]. The open identifications use [lem-cbc-extension-zero-composition] degreewise as justified in step 1. Hence the displayed chain proves the required equality of natural transformations, with all canonical identifications restored.

I checked it against the full statements of all 6 cited nodes, Stacks more-etale 0F7B/0F7C/0F7D (l.2460ff, 2617ff, 2676ff; 0F7B needs only a commutative square, not a cartesian one), the main-20261015 thm-cbc-finite-torsion proof (l.33-43) and the citer's step 11. Step 2: the horizontal formula of lem-cbc-proper-open-interchange-coherence applied to squares (c1,c2,id,w) and R=(b1,b2,w,v), with the refinement normalization, gives alpha_v=(delta c1!)(b2! alpha_w); the types check. Step 3: the two vertical decompositions (R over tower 2, and tower 1 over (i1,i2,id,u)) have the same outer square because p_{Y,2}w=p_{Y,1} and p2 v=u p1. All verticals are proper and all horizontals open. Step 4 is the naturality of gamma_2 at alpha_w. Step 5: I recomputed each line; the compositor identifications follow from the direct-image coherence node, with q2 p2 v=q2 u p1=q1 p1. Coefficients are ordinary small-etale D^+ with Lambda finite (hence torsion), never identified with the pro-etale or adic categories. Edge cases checked: Lambda=0, X empty, identity refinement, and the noncartesian fold example. The tool use of lem-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero-exact is accepted as a generic exactness tool. There is no SGA citation and no cycle. lem-sp-compactification-refinement-coherence and the unbounded and pro-etale composition nodes are not duplicates: they are abstract, carry extra hypotheses, or use other categories. Minor, not changed: proper/open-immersion definitions reach the statement only through the compatible-tower node. No fixes.
